rules: Freeze before edits. Only development and previous failures inform changes. New holdout baseline/final run ONLY after final freeze with exact saved old routing. No same-round changes from holdout answers.

metrics.unsupported: Routing miss (to model) separately from actual unsafe model claims
metrics.answerable: System refusal false positive; clarification friction separate; model refusal separate
metrics.ambiguous: Short system clarification, no completion claim
